description: Combine 2 to 30 booking codes (from the same or different bookmakers) into one deduplicated booking code on a target bookmaker. Reports any skipped, dropped, or conflicting games. Costs 2 credits for the first code, plus 1 credit for each other code on the target bookmaker and 2 credits for each code from another bookmaker; refunded if no code is created.

target.description: Target bookmaker key or alias (defaults to the first pair's bookmaker).

name: mbc_merge_codes
title: Merge 2–30 Bet Codes Into One
